# UPchieve Changelog, week of Oct 5 to Oct 10, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Oct 9, subway Oct 9.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Open the president application to every coach, and tell them chapters are for high schoolers.** A coach no longer needs to have finished onboarding, passed the safety review, tutored a session, or listed high school as their occupation to apply. Any ban blocks applying, `live_media` included, and a submitted application adds the high school occupation to the coach's profile. The apply page and step 1 of the application say chapters are only open to high school students for now, and Continue on step 1 stays off until a 9th to 12th grade is picked, including for coaches whose profile grade is College or Other. The NTHS sidebar link also shows for coaches browsing as a student, and each click is logged with the role it came from. Applications close Oct 30, a date set in the [`nths-application-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/593343) flag's payload. ([subway !3010](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3010), [high-line !1963](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1963)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Removed the NTHS apply preview.** No coach could reach it once the application dropped its requirements, and its flag, [`nths-apply-preview-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/894044), was switched off on Oct 7. An old `/groups/apply-preview` link lands on `/groups/apply`. ([subway !3026](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3026), [high-line !1984](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1984)) *Ben Wheeler*
- **Send coaches' tutored session count to PostHog, so the application flag can target it:** ✅ a `sessionsAsTutor` person property for coaches, the number of sessions they coached with time tutored, set from subway and left off for anyone without a coach role ([subway !3027](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3027)); 👀 the same property sent from the client too, so flag reloads after identify keep it ([high-line !1985](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1985)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Start onboarding's background info from what the coach already gave.** The Background Information form starts from the occupations, grade, and school on the coach's profile, so a coach who applied to NTHS before onboarding doesn't have to re-enter them, and doesn't lose "A high school student" by leaving it unticked. A school preselected in the school search also stops showing a false "Required" after blur. ([high-line !1983](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1983)) *Ben Wheeler*

## API response contracts

A typed, tested contract for every API route's response.

- 🚀 **Contracts and mappers for five more domains:** product flags ([subway !3004](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3004)); referral ([subway !3005](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3005)); progress reports ([subway !3007](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3007)); reports ([subway !3008](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3008)); rewards ([subway !3009](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3009)). Each domain's responses get types in `server/contracts/` and a mapper that builds them from query rows, and its routes return the mapped response, with route tests. These replace the stack opened in July, whose branches had drifted too far from `main` to update cleanly. *Trey Stevens*
- 🎁 **Seven more:** sessions, which also moves everything in `server/public/` to `server/contracts/` ([subway !3011](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3011)); stats ([subway !3012](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3012)); students ([subway !3013](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3013)); subjects ([subway !3014](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3014)); surveys ([subway !3015](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3015)); teachers ([subway !3016](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3016)); training ([subway !3020](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3020)). *Trey Stevens*
- ✅ **Most of the rest:** tutor bot ([subway !3031](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3031)); users ([subway !3032](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3032)); admin user responses ([subway !3037](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3037)); volunteers ([subway !3038](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3038)); auth routes ([subway !3039](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3039)); api-public routes ([subway !3040](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3040), [subway !3043](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3043)); contact routes ([subway !3041](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3041)); eligibility routes ([subway !3042](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3042)); analytics ([subway !3044](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3044)). *Trey Stevens*
- 👀 **Legacy user responses.** ([subway !3033](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3033)) *Trey Stevens*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 🚀 **Block subway merges on the e2e suite.** subway's pipeline runs high-line's e2e tests against the subway commit on every MR and on `main`, and a failure blocks the merge. The job is a template in high-line that both repos run: a high-line pipeline tests its branch against subway's `main`, and a subway pipeline tests its commit against high-line's `main`. ([high-line !1967](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1967), [subway !3017](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3017)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Cover Intro to UPchieve onboarding, and drop the retired quiz's tests:** an e2e from the welcome page through the course to onboarded, which nothing covered, with e2e volunteers seeded with the course, quiz, and certification rows production volunteers have instead of a pass on the retired UPchieve 101 quiz ([high-line !1976](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1976)); the UPchieve 101 tests removed, since the quiz has had no attempt since Mar 26 and its retake test kept flaking, and take-quiz's retake test now finishes the retake and checks the pass ([high-line !1968](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1968)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Make CI runs quicker to start and easier to debug:** e2e starts with the pipeline instead of waiting about 107 seconds for the build stage, MR runs skip the 24-second pnpm cache upload, and a subway that never answers `/healthz` prints the last 200 lines of its log ([high-line !1973](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1973)); an HTML report saved as an artifact alongside the list output ([high-line !1969](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1969)); one retry for a failed test, with a trace recorded only on that retry ([high-line !1970](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1970)). *Ben Wheeler, Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Steady the flaky specs:** the math keyboard test grants the notifications permission and dismisses the whiteboard's alerts itself, since both were failing it ([high-line !1977](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1977)); every spec logs in through one `loginAs` helper, which also dismisses the Zwibbler demo's alerts that were failing session specs with "No dialog is showing"; specs query the shared DB pool instead of checking out clients (take-quiz leaked one per test); and `createVolunteer` and `createStudent` throw on a failed seed instead of returning undefined ([high-line !1982](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1982)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Stop dropping chat messages sent right after typing.** Pressing Enter right after typing into an empty chat box did nothing until TipTap caught up two animation frames later, which also made the chat e2e tests flaky. The send check reads the editor's text directly now, and the e2e `hasMessage` helper only matches sent messages. ([high-line !1990](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1990)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Give urgent hotfixes a way past the tests.** Setting `TEST_DISABLED` on a fresh pipeline in GitLab skips the tests, and the test job becomes optional so it can be cancelled; cancelling it alone still doesn't let the MR merge. A trial run showed that skipping the tests on its own left the deploy jobs blocked, since they wait on the test job ([subway !3022](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3022)). ([subway !3029](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3029)) *Jamie Kasulis*

## TypeScript conversion

Moving high-line from JavaScript to TypeScript.

- 🚀 **The bootstrapped flags, auth status, login, logout, and check-register calls converted:** new network helpers that unwrap axios's `data` and turn any failure into a `NetworkError`, so a caller checks one error type, plus the bootstrapped flags call and `main.js` as `main.ts` ([high-line !1947](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1947)); auth status ([high-line !1948](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1948)); login ([high-line !1953](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1953)); logout ([high-line !1957](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1957)); check register ([high-line !1958](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1958)). *Trey Stevens*

## Component library

Pulling high-line's presentation components out of the components that handle data, so non-engineers can change how the app looks without affecting how it works.

- 🚀 **Split the text input into a presentation `TextField` and the `FormInput` that handles its data,** dropping the Vuetify component it had been built on. ([high-line !1961](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1961)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🎁 **Move the app's text, email, password, and checkbox inputs onto the form components:** text inputs replaced with `FormInput` ([high-line !1966](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1966)); `FormEmail` and `FormPassword` built on presentation components, with a `PasswordField` that owns the requirement wording, the checklist, and the show/hide eye ([high-line !1972](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1972)); email and password fields replaced with those, so every password field gets the show/hide eye and a requirements checklist in place of hint text, and the reset- and set-password pages show validation messages ([high-line !1974](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1974)); a presentation `CheckboxField` inside `FormCheckBox` ([high-line !1975](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1975)); the second checkbox component, `CheckBox`, replaced with `FormCheckBox` ([high-line !1989](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1989)); raw checkbox inputs replaced with `FormCheckBox`, which gains a green option for the presession survey ([high-line !1993](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1993)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Hand the presentation components to Iulia:** 🎁 Iulia made a code owner of `src/components/PresentationComponents/` and the six SCSS token files ([high-line !1995](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1995)); 👀 stylelint on that folder only, so colors, spacing, radius, fonts, and transitions there must use a variable or mixin from `src/scss/setup`, checked on pre-commit and in CI ([high-line !1998](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1998)). *Chris*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Make the grade level save action read as a button.** Students weren't saving their grade level: "Confirm" was green text sitting where a field label goes. It's a blue primary "Save" button now. It's blue rather than our green primary because white text on that green has 1.94:1 contrast, which fails AA. The academic year also came out of the field label here and on the profile page, since the heading above already says it. [#727](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/727) ([high-line !1917](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1917)) *Iulia Rontu*
- **Close holes in SSO sign-in:** 🚀 Clever and ClassLink sign-in check an OAuth2 `state` token, closing a login CSRF where an attacker could get a victim signed into the attacker's account, and a student who starts from Clever or ClassLink, with no token saved yet, is sent back through the flow from our side so one can be added ([subway !2999](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2999)); 🎁 a sign-in redirect path has to start with a single `/`, or it falls back to `/` (or `/login` after a failed login), since a value like `@example.com` would have become the host ([subway !3045](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3045)); 👀 the sign-up SSO buttons send only the fields subway reads, instead of every form field, which put the password in the URL and in subway's session ([high-line !1999](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1999)). *Alex Lindsay, Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Log the outcome of every SSO callback.** The "SSO callbacks failing before token exchange" alert paged on Oct 7 for logins that were working. It counts callbacks that make no outbound call, and since the `state` check, some callbacks restart the flow on purpose. Each callback now logs one `SSO callback` line with its outcome (`restart`, `success`, `needsEmail`, or `failed`), plus the reason for a failure, so the alert can count real failures. ([subway !3019](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3019)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Add `image_upload` as a moderation type,** with its own threshold and penalty weight for each of 23 moderation categories. Nothing reads its settings yet. ([subway !2934](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2934)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🎁 **Keep secrets and personal details out of subway's logs.** Query strings come off logged URLs and referers. Cookies, the authorization, API-key, load-test-key, CSRF, Twilio-signature, and reCAPTCHA headers, and `set-cookie` on responses are all removed. The request and config objects on logged errors are dropped, and phone numbers in the text-message log are masked. ([subway !3035](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3035)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Make PostgreSQL Anonymizer available on a local database,** to try out the security labels that will mask PII on the replica. ([subway !2986](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2986)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Offer post-session messages after every session in Session History.** Both people now get the "you can still message" prompt after any session that shows in Session History, instead of only when both sent a chat message. A session shows there when a coach joined and more than a minute was tutored, whiteboard and doc work included. Sessions with a banned participant don't get the prompt, since their messages are dropped anyway. ([subway !3018](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3018)) *Ben Wheeler*
- **Give subway's logger one typed signature:** 🎁 `logger.*` takes the message first and an optional context second, typed instead of `any`, so log lines come out in one consistent shape, across 108 files ([subway !3034](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3034)); 👀 `logError` removed in favor of `logger.error` ([subway !3036](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3036)); 👀 `/server/worker/logger` folded into `/server/logger` ([subway !3047](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3047)); 👀 ESLint added to subway with one rule on, `use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable`, so `tsc` catches `.catch()` callbacks still logging in the old argument order ([subway !3046](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3046)). *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Take a student or coach who missed the end of a session to the review instead of an error.** A student who refreshed after their coach ended the session landed on the dashboard and couldn't rate it. subway registers every socket handler before setting up the connection. A `sessions:join` sent right after connecting or reconnecting is no longer dropped until the client retries, and a refused join no longer clears a different session the socket joined in the meantime ([subway !2991](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2991)). A join refused because the session ended carries `code: SESSION_ENDED` for the session's own student and coach, on both the HTTP join and the `sessions:join` reply ([subway !2993](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2993)). high-line uses that code: a participant whose page missed the end sees the ended screen in place when the connection comes back, or lands on the review after a reload or reopened tab (the dashboard if the partner never took part). End and Finish replace history, so Back from the review no longer reloads the ended session ([high-line !1941](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1941)). 🐛 [#733](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/733) *Ben Wheeler*
- **Let a student reach every class they're in.** A student who moved up to high school could only see their old middle school classes, because the tab strip at the top cut off anything past about seven. 🚀 the tabs are a dropdown now, newest class first, and joining a class opens it ([high-line !1964](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1964)); 👀 My Classes gets a home page and a right sidebar for moving between classes, after the nested navigation in Progress Reports, with Back always returning to My Classes ([high-line !1965](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1965)). *Chris*
- 🚀 **Show the training page's loader until its subjects arrive.** The page rendered its subject section as soon as the training course loaded, before the subjects had, so on most loads it threw and blanked the page for a moment. It also shows the loading error now if the subjects fail to load. ([high-line !1997](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1997)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Split high-line's dependencies into separate chunks again.** The build had been putting every dependency into one giant `.pnpm-<guid>` chunk. The fix made after the pnpm update ([high-line !1659](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1659)) was reverted at some point and never re-applied. ([high-line !1945](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1945)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Lint against `../` imports in high-line.** ESLint rejects `../` imports in `src` and `../` paths into `src` from tests, and the existing ones use `@/` now. Three `vi.mock` calls pointed at paths that didn't exist and mocked nothing, so they're gone, and the survey spec's `AnalyticsService` mock now actually loads. ([high-line !1996](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1996)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Keep generated test emails under the validator's 64-character local-part limit.** About once every 600 calls, `getEmail()` built an address that `validator.isEmail` rejects, and that failed `AuthService.test.ts` on `main`. ([subway !3003](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3003)) *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Send a signed-out user to `/login` from anywhere.** The API's 401 redirect was a relative path, so from a session page it could go to `/session/math/algebra-one/login`, which treated `login` as the session id and failed with a 500. ([high-line !1988](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1988)) *Trey Stevens*
- 👀 **Send volunteers back to the first sign-up step after a reload.** Reloading the "about" step failed with "email: undefined is not a string" and created no account, for about 118 visitors in the last 30 days. It returns to the first step now, keeping the partner key and team invite code in the URL. A partner link also stops carrying over into a later open sign-up in the same tab. Partner links now land on `?partnerKey=`, and old `?partnerId=` links still work. ([high-line !1971](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1971)) *Ben Wheeler*
